Question 13
?

Find the singular solution to the following Clairaut differential equation: y=xy′+ey′.

a
y=x(ln⁡(x)+1),x>0
b
y=x(ln⁡(−x)−1),x<0
c
y=x2(ln⁡(−x)−1),x<0
d
y=ln⁡(−x)−1,x<0
e
y=x(ln⁡(x)−1),x>0
Submit
